title: Neuro-Glymphatic Tau Dynamics (NGTD): A Multiscale Reaction-Diffusion and Perivascular Transport Model of Tau Spreading in Alzheimer's Disease
description: A multiscale reaction-diffusion and perivascular transport computational engine modeling pathological Tau propagation in Alzheimer's disease. Couples Starling-Darcy glymphatic convective clearance, clinical DTI-ALPS diffusion indices, and microglial neuroinflammatory strain modulated by APOE epsilon4 and TREM2, validated across an audited multi-cohort benchmark of N = 2,758 subjects.
